science.title: In 2025, astronomers discovered 3I/ATLAS, only the third confirmed interstellar object. 1 year later, its heavy water revealed clues to a cold alien planetary system
science.description: In 2025, astronomers discovered 3I/ATLAS, only the third confirmed interstellar object. 1 year later, its heavy water revealed clues to a cold alien planetary system. ALMA and the James Webb Space Telescope found high deuterium levels in its water. The result suggests that its ice formed below about 30 kelvin and preserved chemical evidence from another planetary system for billions of years before entering the Solar System.

science.title: In the 1960s, 2025 PN7 began travelling in step with Earth. 60 years later, American astronomers discovered it and found older images hiding the asteroid in plain sight
science.description: 2025 PN7 was hiding in plain sight for decades. The tiny asteroid has been traveling around the Sun in step with Earth since roughly the 1960s, according to orbital calculations. Astronomers only recognized its unusual connection in 2025 after Pan-STARRS 1 detected it. Older telescope images also captured the faint object. Now, researchers are tracing its path through years of archived observations and learning more about Earths quiet quasi-satellite.
